$comment: GOLDEN FACTS read from the source document, NOT from FinSight output.
An NBFC's press-release KPI table, 'Rs in Cr.', two quarters OLDEST FIRST, then a
'Growth (Y-o-Y)' column that is excluded. Costs print with a MINUS SIGN ('-3,466'),
not brackets. 'Net Income' here is total income LESS finance cost (7,331 - 3,466 =
3,865) -- NOT net income in the sense of profit (metric net_total_income). 'Total
Expenses' is operating expenses: finance cost and loan losses are separate lines
(PBT = net income - total expenses - loan losses); the literal key is accepted too.
AUM is a balance at the quarter end. The basis is not stated on the table: null.
Native page; figures from the text layer.

Phase 22: every row carries 'metric', the canonical key its printed label names, decided by reading the label in its statement (null: the taxonomy has no key for the line); 'metric_alt' lists keys that name the same measure. The scorer checks the key, not only the printed label.
